Thanks for the context. SOC2 redacted + project plan are sufficient for a hosted promo at this level. A couple of security notes to include in outreach to the customer:
- Confirm that all data used for de-identification is either synthetic or already legally permitted to process; if not, request a short Data Processing Addendum (we have a slim DPA template).
- Recommend they enable KV-prefix caching and limit max tokens per request to avoid accidental spikes.
- No special infrastructure signoff required for hosted credits; if they request Dedicated capacity, re-evaluate.

Approve: 50,000 token promo credit + 90-day trial extension. Marissa — you can go ahead and issue the promo and send the standard promo-credits-agreement.pdf. I'll note the compliance checks in the ticket.
